newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hefei Meiling '96 net surges 45.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hefei Meiling '96 net surges 45.47 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net assets per share 3.61 yuan vs 3.47 yuan
Earnings per share 0.49 yuan vs 0.69 yuan
Company name: Hefei Meiling Co Ltd.

Note: the results were published in a company statement issued on Tuesday. The post-tax profit figure is based on international accounting standards and the other figures on domestic accounting standards.
Based on domestic accounting standards, the 1996 net was 144.9438 million yuan against 112.41 million yuan.
Earnings per share is calculated on a fully diluted basis. On a weighted average basis, the earnings would be 0.62 yuan per share for 1996.

The company's board of directors has proposed a 1.31-for-10 bonus issue to B share holders and a 3.5-for-10 bonus issue to A share holders, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting scheduled for April 26.
The company's B shares were listed on August 28, 1996.
